title: Uttarakhand Purv Sainik Kalyan Nigam Ltd. v. Northern Coal Field Ltd.

content.caseIdentity: Uttarakhand Purv Sainik Kalyan Nigam Ltd. v. Northern Coal Field Ltd., (2020) 2 SCC 455
content.facts: At the Section 11 stage, limitation was raised as an objection to the proposed arbitration.
questionsBeforeCourt: Whether preliminary jurisdictional objections such as limitation should be decided by the referral court or arbitral tribunal.
content.ratioDecidendi: Section 16 is an inclusive competence-competence provision; once the arbitration agreement exists, preliminary jurisdictional objections such as limitation are ordinarily for the tribunal.
content.holding: The Court held that such jurisdictional issues should be left to the arbitral tribunal rather than determined at the pre-reference stage.
content.relevance: Foundational authority on Section 16 competence-competence and the division of jurisdiction between court and tribunal.
